sb_prompt: WHAT IS BEING DONE IN YOUR COMMUNITY OR AREA ABOUT RECYCLING WASTE MATERIALS?  DO YOU THINK MORE SHOULD BE DONE?  DO YOU HAVE ANY IDEAS ON HOW TO ENCOURAGE MORE RECYCLING OR ON WHAT OTHER MATERIALS SHOULD BE INCLUDED?
turns: You called about that recycling thing, huh?
Yeah, right. I mean, here we got that new bin thing out by the corner, but honestly? Nobody even uses it.
That's rough, I guess. We got those blue bins down here too at the bank, but honestly people just throw their trash in 'em 'cause the regular bags look full enough.

Yeah, exactly. My ex-wife used to bring me in to fix her car and she'd got all these big plastic bottles full of water and she was like "I'm gonna recycle this" and I'd just say "Honey, put it in the trash, save yourself the trouble.
Yeah, I figured she just wanted to feel good about it, but the truth is, it's a waste of time if you gotta haul it to the drop-off point yourself.
Yeah, but I think if we made the bins separate for plastics and glass, maybe folks would actually take the extra step to sort it out.

Yeah, that's a shame, but honestly it's easier to just toss everything in one bag and forget about it.
Yeah, but maybe we could put stickers on the bins showing exactly what goes where? Like pictures so people don't have to read all the fine print?
Yeah, pictures would probably help, but I just worry that if it gets too complicated, people are gonna get annoyed and stop doing it altogether.
Yeah, I think pictures are the only way people will actually look, but I guess if they think it's too much work, they might just give up again.
Yeah, maybe pictures would be better, but I still think we need to make it so easy that people don't even have to think about it before they toss the bag out.

Yeah, that could work, but I'm worried about the glass breaking up in the truck if it's not wrapped right, or something like that.

Yeah, I guess we could try that, but my cousin works at a plant nearby and he said if they make the glass bins too big, the whole thing gets blown over in the wind and then it's just a mess on the street anyway.
Yeah, he said they had to use little bags inside 'cause loose glass just cuts the truck bed up and then they just throw it all in the landfill anyway.
Yeah, I guess he's right about the glass, I just don't wanna deal with broken stuff in the truck.
Yeah, I guess we could put bags inside 'cause loose glass just cuts the truck bed up and then they just throw it all in the landfill anyway.

Yeah, but then people just leave the bags tied shut and the driver dumps 'em right there and then we're back to square one.
Yeah, but then the bags just stay tied up and nobody even opens 'em to check what's inside before they get tossed.
Yeah, but if you make 'em too small people just fill 'em up with trash again instead of the right stuff.
Yeah, but if they're too small, nobody's gonna bother filling 'em to the brim like we expect.
Yeah, but then people just throw the whole thing in the trash because they don't want to figure out which one is which.
Yeah, but if they make the bags too small people just fill 'em with garbage instead.
Yeah, but then they just end up just throwing everything in the trash anyway and we lose everything.
Yeah, I guess we just end up throwing it all out anyway.
Yeah, but if we make it one big bin again nobody will bother sorting at all.
Yeah, but if they just throw it all in the trash anyway, what's the point of having three bins?
Yeah, I guess we're just stuck in that loop where nobody wants to do the extra work so we might as well just put it all in the trash like you said.
Yeah, I guess if sorting is too much trouble, folks will just stop trying altogether.
Yeah, I guess if nobody's gonna take the time to separate it first, might as well just send it all back to the landfill than pay to haul the wrong stuff.
Yeah, I guess we're stuck there, but honestly it just feels like nobody wants to lift a finger unless it costs them nothing to do it.
Yeah, but if we just make it super easy for them, maybe they'll actually start doing it without thinking twice.
Yeah, I guess if you make it super easy, maybe folks will actually bother doing it.
Yeah, that's probably it, just gotta keep it simple enough so they don't have to think about it.
Yeah, I guess that's the thing, if it ain't worth the hassle, nobody's gonna bother.
Yeah, as long as it's worth the trouble though, I suppose.
